info.name: Unichat Backend API
info.description: Unichat backend APIs. **Public client / mobile base:** `{{gateway_base}}/api` (API Gateway, default port 4225). Web and mobile apps should use this host for: auth OTP, registration complete, user (find/create/update/deactivate), **contact matching** (`POST /api/users/match-contacts`, JWT required), **conversations**, and **messages**. The gateway forwards to the respective microservices. Direct service ports (4226–4230, etc.) are for local debugging or service-to-service use.

item.name: 📌 API Gateway (4225)
item.description: Public base URL: `{{gateway_base}}/api`. Clients (web/mobile) should use these routes for auth, registration, user lifecycle, **contact discovery** (`POST /api/users/match-contacts` with `Authorization: Bearer` from OTP verify), conversations, and messages (same paths as downstream services, e.g. `GET /api/conversations`, `POST /api/messages/text`).

request.description:
Complete user registration after OTP verify. Send JSON body with optional base64 profilePhoto.

Validation rules:
- phoneNumber: E.164 format (e.g. +94771234567)
- username: 3-50 chars, alphanumeric + underscore only, must be unique
- email: valid email, must be unique
- profilePhoto: optional, base64 string or data-URI (image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif, max 5 MB)

Behavior:
- If profile already completed: returns existing user (200)
- If user exists but incomplete: updates and returns (200)
- If user does not exist: creates new user (200)

Errors:
- 400: validation failure or invalid image
- 409: username or email already taken
- 500: Cloudinary upload failure

response.name: 400 - Validation error

formdata.description: 3-50 chars, alphanumeric + underscore, must be unique
Valid email address, must be unique

request.description:
Complete user registration with file upload via multipart/form-data. Same behavior as the JSON variant, but the profile photo is sent as a file instead of base64.

The gateway converts the uploaded file to base64 before forwarding to user-service internally.

Discover which E.164 numbers from the device address book belong to registered UniChat users. **Clients must request OS Contacts permission** and explain why (e.g. "find people you know on UniChat").

**Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` from `POST /api/auth/otp/verify` (`accessToken`). The gateway verifies JWT; responses must never reveal registered numbers to anonymous callers.

**Request body:**
- `phoneNumbers` (required): array of normalized E.164 strings. Before sending, strip spaces/dashes; the client should normalize to E.164 (country code included). Invalid entries or wrong shape → **400**.
- `excludeSelf` (optional): when `true`, omits the signed-in user if their own number appears in the list.

**Limits:** At most **1000** numbers per request (gateway + user-service).

**Normalization:** Trimming and internal whitespace removal are applied server-side; invalid numbers are rejected.

**Eligible match:** `status` ACTIVE, not soft-deleted (`deletedAt` null), `accountStatus` true, `profileCompleted` true. Users blocked by you or who blocked you are excluded. `profilePhoto` is omitted when the matched user disabled photo sharing in privacy settings.

**Response:** `{ "matches": [ ... ] }` only for hits. Numbers with no eligible match are **omitted** (not listed as "not found") to reduce response size.

Each match: `phoneNumber`, `userId` (same UUID as JWT `sub` for that user — use as `participantUserId` in `POST /api/conversations/private`), optional `displayName`, `username`, `profilePhoto`.

**Errors:** **400** validation, **401** missing/invalid/expired token, **429** rate limited (best-effort per gateway instance; defaults ~30 requests / signed-in user / minute and ~120 / client IP / minute — tune with `CONTACT_MATCH_RATE_MAX`, `CONTACT_MATCH_RATE_MAX_PER_IP`, `CONTACT_MATCH_RATE_WINDOW_MS`).

**Privacy:** Server logs only counts (batch size and match count), not the number list. This API does **not** accept hashed numbers; use plaintext E.164 over TLS with auth + rate limits.

**Future:** A `discoverableByPhone` (or similar) privacy flag can further restrict matches without changing the URL.

response.name: 400 - invalid number in batch
401 - no token
429 - rate limited

request.description: Forwarded to user-service. Optional fields: displayName, username, email, profilePhoto (base64 or data-URI, max ~10 MB through gateway).

item.name: 🔐 Auth Service (4226 — generate only)
item.description: Direct auth-service calls. OTP **verify** for clients is on the API Gateway (`{{gateway_base}}/api/auth/otp/verify`).

request.description: Same URL clients use. Gateway forwards to auth-service. For service-only testing without the gateway, call auth-service :4226 directly.

item.name: 👤 User Service (4227 — internal / service ports)
item.description: **Client apps:** user APIs live on the gateway (same paths as user-service). The first two requests below use `{{gateway_base}}`; **Complete Profile (internal)** and similar still point at user-service **directly** on port 4227 for debugging and gateway forwarding.

request.description: user-service endpoint used by the gateway after JWT verification. **Do not expose publicly** without the same trust model. Prefer `POST {{gateway_base}}/api/users/match-contacts` with Bearer token from clients.

Internal endpoint called by api-gateway. Do not call directly from clients.

Sets username, email, and optional profile photo (base64) for a user. Uploads photo to Cloudinary.

Returns 409 if username or email is already taken by another user.

item.name: 🔑 OTP / login (API Gateway)
item.description: Public paths on the gateway (port 4225). **Request** forwards to otp-service `POST /api/otp/request`. **Verify** forwards to auth-service `POST /api/auth/otp/verify`. For raw otp-service debugging: `http://localhost:4228/api/otp/request`.

request.description: Client URL: `POST /api/auth/otp/request` on the API Gateway.
Client URL: `POST /api/auth/otp/verify` on the API Gateway.
Bypasses the gateway; hits otp-service only. Use when isolating otp-service behaviour.

item.name: 💬 Conversations (API Gateway → conversation-service :4229)
item.description: Client URL base: `{{gateway_base}}/api/conversations` (gateway forwards to conversation-service). For isolation testing, call `http://localhost:4229/api/conversations` directly.

request.description: Create a new group conversation. For the `imageUrl` property, you can provide either a public HTTP URL or a base64-encoded image string (`data:image/png;base64,...`) to directly upload the group DP via Cloudinary.

Update settings for a group conversation. The `imageUrl` property handles updating the group DP and supports either an HTTP URL or a base64-encoded image string (`data:image/png;base64,...`) for direct upload via Cloudinary.

item.name: 📱 Messages (API Gateway → messaging-service :4230)
item.description: Client URL base: `{{gateway_base}}/api/messages` (gateway forwards to messaging-service). For isolation testing, call `http://localhost:4230/api/messages` directly.
